move_tensors_to_device: move a PyTorch tensor or dict of tensors to a specified device and detach them
flatten_tensor_first_two_dims: flatten the first two dimensions of a PyTorch tensor or dict of tensors into one
slice_tensor_along_dimension: slice a PyTorch tensor or dict of tensors along a given dimension with start and end indices
index_tensor_along_dimension: index a single element from a PyTorch tensor or dict of tensors along a given dimension
set_random_seeds: set random seeds for Python, NumPy, and PyTorch including CUDA for reproducibility
